studyMetadata.title: CALVI Annotation Study
studyMetadata.description: 30 items from the reVISit calvi library (sequence 'specificBank') with multiple-choice answers and drawing. Generated by scripts/import_library_items.py. L. W. Ge, Y. Cui, and M. Kay, “CALVI: Critical Thinking Assessment for Literacy in Visualizations,” in Proceedings of the 2023 CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI '23), New York, NY, USA: Association for Computing Machinery, 2023, Art. no. 815, pp. 1–18.

fixation.description: Fixation-cross pupil baseline on neutral grey; auto-advances after durationMs.

response.prompt: Fixation baseline
Drawing scene

graph.description: Mini-VLAT item with an Excalidraw drawing layer over the graph; per-item question, options, and answer key come from the component. To use the pointer event log instead, set path to annotation-probe/AnnotationTrial.tsx and the reactive response id to annotationEvents.

nasa-tlx.description: NASA Task Load Index (raw TLX, 0-100 in steps of 5).
nasa-tlx.instruction: Rate the graph task you just completed on each scale.

response.prompt: Mental Demand: How mentally demanding was the task?
Physical Demand: How physically demanding was the task?
Temporal Demand: How hurried or rushed was the pace of the task?
Performance: How successful were you in accomplishing what you were asked to do?
Effort: How hard did you have to work to accomplish your level of performance?
Frustration: How insecure, discouraged, irritated, stressed, and annoyed were you?

consent.description: PLACEHOLDER consent page; replace consent.md with the approved IRB text before running participants.

response.prompt: Do you consent to take part in this study?

introduction.description: Study introduction without the fixation step; the participant presses Start when ready.

response.prompt: What is the number of visitors at theater A as a proportion of that at theater B in 2001?
Which statement about the daily number of traffic accidents from Jan 01 to Jan 15 in state Z is true?

options.label: It was higher on Jan 08 than Jan 07.
It increased from Jan 11 to Jan 15.
All of the days had more than 25 accidents.
It decreased from Jan 03 to Jan 07.

response.prompt: Which of the following statements is true about the customers at the three bike shops in city Z?

options.label: On Jul 02, shop B had more customers than A and C combined.
The number of customers at shop C decreased from Jul 01 to Jul 03.
The number of customers at shop A increased from Jul 01 to Jul 03.

response.prompt: Which of the following is true about the advertising expense breakdown of company Z in countries A, B, and C?

options.label: Advertising expense for TV & radio was higher than that from social media in country A.
In country C, company Z had less advertising expense for direct mail than the other two methods.
Company Z had the highest total advertising expense in country B.

response.prompt: Which of the following is true about the four brands of perfume in city Z?

options.label: The market share of brand D is on an increasing trend from 2011 to 2015.
The market share of brand A is higher in 2011 than in 2012.
In 2013, brand B had the largest market share among all four brands.

response.prompt: Which of the following about the monthly number of new clients is true?

options.label: It decreased from Mar to Jun for company A.
It is higher in Feb for company B than company A.
It increased from Sep to Dec for company B.

response.prompt: What is the trend of the monthly number of new restaurant openings in county Y in 2000?
Is the total number of beers consumed by person Z in the first half of 2005 higher than that in the second half?

meta.title: Store C’s Sales vs Store B

response.prompt: Approximately, what is store C’s total sales as a proportion of store B’s total sales in 1995?
Is there a positive relationship between SAT score and annual family income for students in city Z?
Which of the following is true about the residents in towns X and Y?

options.label: There is a negative relationship between sleep quality score and average weekly hours spent outdoors for town X.
There is a positive relationship between sleep quality score and average weekly hours spent outdoors for town Y.
Most residents in town X spend more than 6 hours outdoors every week.

response.prompt: Which of the following is true about the market share of grocery stores in town Z?

options.label: Store A has less than half of the total market share.
Store C has a higher market share than store B.
Store B has the second highest market share.

response.prompt: Which of the following is true about the education level of residents in city Z?

options.label: More than 60% of residents have a Bachelor’s degree or above.
The majority of residents have a graduate degree.
There are fewer residents whose education level is Associate degree than those with a high school degree.

response.prompt: Which of the following states has the highest number of Lego owners?
Which of the following is true about Restaurant R?

options.label: It is more popular in region E than in D.
It is less popular in region A than in C.

response.prompt: What is the number of concert tickets sold on Aug 10 as a proportion of that on Aug 11?
Predatory species Z is more prevalent in NC than in AZ.
Which of the following is true about the annual number of new movies released in city X?

options.label: There were more new movies released in 1992 than in 1994.
2000 had the most number of new movies released.
There were more new movies released in 1996 than in 1995.

response.prompt: Which of the following is true about the prevalence of the plant species Y?

options.label: It is more prevalent in region D than in E.
It is less prevalent in region B than in C.
It is more prevalent in region C than in A.

response.prompt: Which of the following is true about the three brands of shampoo in city Y from 2001 to 2005?

options.label: The market share of brand C is on an increasing trend from 2001 to 2005.
The market share of brand C is higher in 2001 than in 2002.
Brand B had the largest market share in 2001 compared to its market share in the other years.

response.prompt: Approximately, what is the number of votes for candidate A as a proportion of those for candidate B?
Was the average amount of precipitation over 15 years in region D higher than that in region C?

meta.title: Vegetable planting trends by three farms

response.prompt: Assuming today is Feb 20, 2022, which of the following is true about the vegetables planted by the three farms?

options.label: All three farms planted more vegetables in 2022 than they did in the previous years.
All three farms planted fewer vegetables in 2022 than they did in the previous years.
All three farms planted about the same amount of vegetables in 2022 as they did in the previous years.

response.prompt: Assuming today is May 01, 2022, which of the following statements is true?

options.label: Company Z had more new employees in 2018 than in 2020.
The number of new employees per year fell sharply in 2022.
The total number of employees in company Z decreased in 2022.
